component_test_harness.note: Zero *.svelte.test.ts confirmed via find. P1 verifies via pure-core unit tests + static wiring-presence + manual/preview — NOT component tests (portfolio fact held).

additive_persistence_feasibility.approach: If P1 persists a 'last unanalysed gameId', the natural home is SettingsRecord (src/store/db.ts:77-95) as an optional field, mirroring the established pattern: opponentStyle?, lastTimeControl?, metacogEnabled?, locale? — every one additive with a read-site `?? default` and NO DB_VERSION bump.
additive_persistence_feasibility.alternative_no_persistence: P1 can ALSO derive the unanalysed set purely from F5's getAllGames() + getAnalyzedGameIds() at read time (no new field at all). This is the strongest additive posture: zero schema change. See arbitrage Q-A.
additive_persistence_feasibility.justification: Both candidate designs are additive: either a single optional SettingsRecord field (read `?? null`) OR a pure derived read over existing stores. Neither drops/renames/reindexes a store, so DB_VERSION stays 4 (db.ts:121-124 migration policy: additive => no bump).

steering_semantics_baseline.selectOpening: openingBook.ts:81-103 — weights weakest-targeting opening 3:1, else 1:1; null weakest => uniform (neutral variety).
steering_semantics_baseline.steeringNote: openingBook.ts:127-132 — 'Steering toward your weakest area (X)' when matched, else 'Playing the X' (neutral).
steering_semantics_baseline.broken_loop_root: No analyses -> loadAllAnalyses() returns [] -> weakest=null -> neutral opening + neutral note. Closing the loop (any analysed game with a detected weakness) flips this to a steered opening.
